lead_title: Ambitious 127号把机构受赠叙事与具名个人短评分区刊载
observation: 同一期中，机构活动栏介绍AWWA资格视察和长期福利贡献；另一个具名作者栏讨论刻板印象，区分个别军人暴力行为与美军整体，并要求适当回应。后者不是机构声明。
why_unexpected: Recipient publication within one issue contains non-identical voices that would be flattened by page-level discourse coding.
next_test: 未来若研究recipient内部话语差异，应按栏目作者和体裁分层并寻找跨期重复。
potential_value: Could test whether welfare receipt and critical/security discourse coexist within recipient publication ecologies without assuming a single organizational stance.
stop_reason: Outside the four-endpoint LEG2 task; no follow-up was performed and the observation is retained only as a future discourse-method lead.
